readings.description: States the sheet is generated from the IFC model; being a 1.20 m horizontal section at 1:100 the drawing cannot itself establish net slab volumes, so the total is taken from the IFC measurement only.

notes: Coverage gap resolved: exactly one complete measurement is selected for the requested total — IfcSlab net_geometry volume on storey EG (GlobalId 2aIWPvOfn1XvF_7jNsKTBw), 104.63001763356789 m³ (≈104.63 m³).

Completeness: model_inventory reports 40 IfcSlab elements on EG and the measurement reports measured_elements 40 of expected 40 with complete=true and no failures, so this is a total, not a partial element sum.
Basis is computed IFC net solid geometry with represented openings subtracted, not the plan image, not a printed area, and not an image-inferred thickness.

An author-reported BaseQuantities NetVolume sum agreed with the geometric total, but it is a separate method and is intentionally excluded from the selected measurement_ids; it appears only as corroboration.
Scope: only the single supplied page (page-931df9023ee710e64a4d5a52) and the registered source ifc-26734e67bdc0fd2ab30cb560 were used; no other storeys or sheets were inspected.
No object detectors or room polygons were needed, since the question is an IFC volume quantity rather than a plan-image count or room set.
